close_pull-request: Closes a PR without merging it. Ask "close PR 3 in coilyco/app" or "close PR 10 in coilysiren/tools?" To open it again see reopen_pull-request.
create_organization-repository: Returns the repository record it creates inside an org, applying the supplied name, description, private flag, and default branch. Try 'Create a repo called coilyco/backend' or 'Make a private repo under coilyco called migrations'. For repos already in the org use list_organization-repository.
create_pull-request: For 'open a PR from branch X into main' or 'make a pull request for my branch', this creates a new pull request from a head branch into a base branch. To list existing PRs, use list_pull-request.
create_release: Creates a release with tag_name, target commitish, name, notes body, draft and prerelease flags. Ask "create release v1.0.0 on main in coilyco/app?" or "draft a release named Nightly in coilysiren/tool?" See get_repository-release to fetch the release.
dispatch_workflow: Triggers a workflow_dispatch workflow by its file name such as release.yml on a ref. Ask "run release.yml on main in coilyco/app?" or "trigger deploy.yml on v1.2.0 in coilysiren/tool?" See list_action-run for the resulting run.
edit_pull-request: Updates only a PR's title, body, or base branch. It cannot add reviewers, labels, or assignees. Ask "edit PR 5 title in coilyco/app" or "change base branch of PR 7 in coilysiren/tools". For closing without merge see close_pull-request.
edit_release: Edits an existing release by numeric id with name, notes body, draft, and prerelease. Ask "edit release 42 in coilyco/app to change notes?" or "mark release 123 in coilysiren/tool as draft?" See get_repository-release for current release details.
edit_repository: For 'change the description of X', 'set the default branch of X to dev', 'turn off issues on X', or 'disable PRs on X', this edits only description, website, default branch, has_issues, and has_pull_requests. It cannot change wiki, topics, name, or visibility.
get_action-run: Returns one Actions run by run_id with workflow, status, conclusion, commit, and timing. Ask "what happened in run 123456 in coilyco/app?" or "show run 987654 in coilyco/website?" See list_action-run-job for the jobs inside it.
get_commit-status: Returns the combined overall CI state of success, pending, or failure for a commit SHA or branch, plus its statuses. Ask "is commit abc123 green in coilyco/app?" or "what is the CI status on main in coilyco/website?" See list_commit-status for individual status entries.
get_organization: Returns one organization's profile fields: full name, description, website, and visibility. Ask 'What is the coilyco org profile?' or 'Show me coilyco's website.' For who belongs to it use list_organization-member.
get_pull-request: Returns one PR with title, body, state, mergeable, head and base branches, author, and merged status. Ask "get PR 3 details in coilyco/app" or "what is the base branch of PR 9 in coilysiren/tools?" For repo PR list see list_pull-request.
get_pull-request-commit: Returns commits inside one PR, paged. Ask "which commits are in PR 2 in coilyco/app?" or "show PR 9 commits in coilysiren/tools". For file changes see get_pull-request-file.
get_pull-request-file: Returns files changed in one PR with additions and deletions per file, paged. Ask "what files are changed in PR 6 in coilyco/app?" or "show diff stats for PR 11 in coilysiren/tools". For commits inside the PR see get_pull-request-commit.
get_repository: It returns metadata for one repo such as description, default branch, visibility, size, topics, stars, and whether issues, wiki, and PRs are enabled. "What topics does coilyco/website have?" "Does coilysiren/backend have PRs enabled?" Use edit_repository to change description, default branch, or feature flags.
get_repository-branch: For 'is the X branch still there', 'does branch X exist', 'what commit is branch X on', or 'is main protected', this gets one named branch. For listing all branches use list_repository-branch.
get_repository-content: For 'show me the README of X', 'read src/app.py', or 'what's in the docs folder', this reads one file at a path, optionally at a ref, and returns a directory's entries when given a directory. For top-level root use list_repository-content.
get_repository-release: For 'show release v1.2.0 of X' or 'notes for v0.3.1', this gets one release by its tag. For listing all releases use list_repository-release.
list_action-run: Returns Forgejo Actions workflow runs for a repo, filterable by event and status, newest first. Ask "show recent actions runs in coilyco/app?" or "which workflow runs failed on main in coilysiren/tool?" See get_action-run for a single run's details.
list_action-run-job: Returns the jobs inside one Actions run with their status and no logs. Ask "what jobs are in run 123456 in coilyco/app?" or "which jobs failed in run 987654 in coilysiren/tool?" See get_action-run for workflow and conclusion.
list_commit-status: Returns every individual CI status entry with context, state, and description posted on a commit SHA, branch, or tag. Ask "what statuses are on abc123 in coilyco/app?" or "which CI contexts ran on main in coilyco/website?" See get_commit-status for the combined overall state.
list_current-user-organization: For 'what orgs am I in' or 'my orgs', this lists the organizations of the account this server acts as. For another user's orgs use list_user-organization.
list_organization: Returns every organization on the server. Ask 'What orgs are on this server?' or 'List all organizations.' For orgs the bot account belongs to, use list_current-user-organization.
list_organization-member: Returns the members of one specified org. Ask 'Who is in the coilyco org?' or 'List members of the coilyco org.' For the org's description and visibility use get_organization.
list_organization-repository: Returns a list of repositories owned by one specified org. Ask 'What repos does coilyco have?' or 'Show me coilyco's repositories.' For repos owned by a user account, use list_user-repository.
list_pull-request: For 'open PRs on X', 'what PRs are waiting on X', or 'any PRs by kai', this lists a repo's pull requests filtered by state, labels, milestone, or poster. For opening a new PR, use create_pull-request.
list_repository: Returns the repositories the server bot account can see across every owner, honouring order_by. Ask 'What repos can you see?' or 'List every repo the bot can access.' For search by repo name use search_repository.
list_repository-branch: For 'list branches on X' or 'what branches does X have', this lists branches on a repo. For one named branch like 'is main protected' use get_repository-branch.
list_repository-commit: It returns commit history with optional branch or SHA, file path, stats, and changed files. "What are the latest commits on dev in coilyco/website?" "Which commits changed README.md in coilysiren/backend?" Use list_repository-tree to find files by name or extension.
list_repository-content: For 'what's at the root of X' or 'top-level files in X', this lists only the repo's top-level root entries. For reading a file or directory inside the repo, use get_repository-content.
list_repository-label: It returns issue and PR labels defined on a repo. "What labels can I use on coilyco/website PRs?" "Which issue labels exist in coilysiren/backend?" Use get_repository to see if issues and PRs are enabled.
list_repository-release: For 'what's the latest release of X', 'newest version of X', or 'releases of X', this lists releases for a repo. For one release by tag like 'show release v1.2.0 of X' use get_repository-release.
list_repository-tag: Returns git tags of a repo with their commits. Ask "what tags exist in coilyco/app?" or "what commit is tag v1.0.0 in coilysiren/tool?" See list_repository-release for releases.
list_repository-tree: For 'find every python file in X' or 'every file path in X', this walks the whole git tree for a branch or SHA and recursively lists every path. For top-level root use list_repository-content.
list_user-organization: For 'what orgs is coilysiren in', this lists the organizations of another named user. For 'what orgs am I in' use list_current-user-organization.
list_user-repository: Returns repositories owned by one named user account. Ask 'What repos does coilysiren have?' or 'Show me coilysiren's repos.' For repos owned by an org, use list_organization-repository.
mcp_beaver_info: Report this MCP server's identity, mode, and served tool inventory. Read-only, reaches no upstream, and doubles as a liveness probe now that the protocol ping is gone.
merge_pull-request: Merges a PR with style merge, squash, rebase, or fast-forward-only, optional merge title and message, and optional branch deletion after merge. Ask "merge PR 4 in coilyco/app with squash" or "merge PR 6 in coilysiren/tools and delete branch". To close instead see close_pull-request.
reopen_pull-request: Reopens a closed, unmerged PR. Ask "reopen PR 3 in coilyco/app" or "reopen PR 10 in coilysiren/tools?" For closing without merge see close_pull-request.
search_repository: Returns repositories matching repo name and optionally description or topic, with filters for private, archived, template, fork or mirror mode. Ask 'Find repos named backend' or 'Search private repos named migrations'. It never searches file contents. For topic names use search_topic.
search_topic: Returns matching topic names with how many repos use each topic. Ask 'What topics match go?' or 'How many repos use kubernetes?' It returns topics, not repos. For repos matching a topic use search_repository.
